definition: [ יָבַם ] verb denominative , only Pi`el do the duty of יָבָם to a brother's widow; Perfect וְיִבְּמָהּ consecutive Deut 25:5 and shall do a brother-in-law's office to her; Imperative יַבֵּם אֹתָהּ Gen 38:8 (i.e. אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ v a ); Infinitive suffix לֹא אָבָה יַבְּמִי Deut 25:7 (on nominal suffix as object of infinitive, see Ges «GKC:115»§ 115 R. 2 near the end). יַבְנְאֵל , יַבְנֶה , יִבְנְיָה , יִבְנִיָּה see below בנה . יַבֹּק see below בקק above יְבֶרֶכְיָ֫הוּ see below ברך above יִבְשָׂם see below בשׂם above
